title: tools
name: tools
description: Also holds the damage report's note as `damage_note`. A CHECK keeps `condition` to good or needs_repair.

title: loans
name: loans
description: Also holds the return as `returned_at`, `return_condition` and `return_note`. CHECKs keep `due_date` a date and `return_condition` to good or needs_repair.

title: catalog
name: catalog
description: Worked out from the tools and loans tables on each request (ToolService.list); never kept.
